author: Daniele Morais
title: Magnitude 5.8 earthquake strikes near Toride (Japan)
subtitle: The quake was recorded at a depth of 78 km, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS).
excerpt: A magnitude 5.8 earthquake was recorded near Toride (Japan), at a depth of 78 km, according to the USGS.
contentHtml:
A magnitude 5.8 earthquake was recorded on August 22, 2026 at 02:00 PM (Brasília time) near Toride (Japan), according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). The quake occurred at a depth of roughly 78 km.

What this magnitude means

Earthquakes in this range are moderate and rarely cause severe structural damage, but are widely felt.

What to expect in the coming days

After a main shock, aftershocks — smaller quakes in the same region — are expected over the following days and weeks, with frequency decreasing over time, a well-established pattern in seismology.

With data from the USGS (United States Geological Survey).
